name: Combination Discipline — Draught of the Soul

system.description:
Many Assamites, particularly among the warrior caste, raise the potency of their blood through Amaranth, and those who walk the Road of Blood are especially enamored of the practice. This art allows the diablerist to drain not only a victim's power but a measure of her knowledge as well, though frequent use risks leaving the diablerist's own mind cluttered with fragments of her victims.

System: This power may be invoked whenever the character successfully commits diablerie. The player spends Willpower Traits equal to the victim's Intelligence and wins a Willpower challenge (difficulty increased by one for every derangement the victim had). On success, the character gains experience usable only toward Abilities in which the victim's rating was equal to or greater than her own, and receives a dreamlike glimpse of some of the victim's most significant memories (left to the Storyteller's discretion, and best used to plant hints rather than hand over plot-critical knowledge). A botch grants no knowledge and instead saddles the character with a permanent derangement, preferably one the victim possessed.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
